scope: conditional training-set sensitivity on previously exposed development data only
design: pool the two prior 56-group support sets and split each diagnosis into complementary random sets of 8 from 16. Independently split the two prior 128-group risk-fit sets into complementary random sets of 128 from 256. Cross all four combinations. Pair allocations across the two frozen backbones.
target: paired error AUROC increment from parent_js in the existing image-centroid risk model
risk_fit: retain original logistic features, training-only scaling, penalties, taxonomy and checkpoint logit scales
summary: median, empirical 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles, positive and negative counts by backbone and cohort, same-sign counts across settings, and within-partition squared support/fit/interaction contrasts
control: reproduce all four original allocation cells before random reallocation
scope_limit: evaluation and available training cases are fixed; repeated cells are dependent. Descriptive frequencies concern this finite pool, not independent external replications, p-values or population confidence intervals.
